props.description: When you hit a creature with an attack, if the attack only targeted that creature and they are suffering from one or more status effects, you may have it deal extra damage equal to 【SL + the number of status effects on the creature】.
props.name: Cheap Shot
props.passive_logic_action:
const TAG = "[PASSIVE][CheapShot][MainAttack]";

const norm = (v) => String(v ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();

const skipHidden = (reason = "") => {

__PAYLOAD.meta = __PAYLOAD.meta || {};

__PAYLOAD.meta.hidePassiveCard = true;

return context.skipPassive(reason, { notify: false });

};

// --------------------------------------------------

// 0) IMPORTANT:

// Cheap Shot should modify the ORIGINAL attack payload,

// not the separate autoPassive self-execution payload.

// So if this passive is currently running as autoPassive,

// skip here.

// --------------------------------------------------

const isAutoPassiveExecution =

__PAYLOAD?.meta?.isPassiveExecution === true ||

__PAYLOAD?.isPassiveExecution === true ||

norm(__PAYLOAD?.meta?.executionMode) === "autopassive" ||

norm(__PAYLOAD?.executionMode) === "autopassive";

if (isAutoPassiveExecution) {

return skipHidden("");

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 1) Owner / item

// --------------------------------------------------

const passiveOwner =

__PASSIVE_ACTOR ??

context.passiveOwner ??

null;

const passiveItem =

__PASSIVE_ITEM ??

context.passiveItem ??

null;

if (!passiveOwner || !passiveItem) {

return skipHidden("");

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 2) Resolve current action targets from the MAIN attack payload

// Cheap Shot only works if the attack only targeted 1 creature.

// --------------------------------------------------

const declaredTargets = [

...new Set(

(

(Array.isArray(__PAYLOAD?.originalTargetUUIDs) && __PAYLOAD.originalTargetUUIDs.length)

? __PAYLOAD.originalTargetUUIDs

: (Array.isArray(__PAYLOAD?.targets) ? __PAYLOAD.targets : [])

)

.filter(Boolean)

.map(String)

)

];

if (declaredTargets.length !== 1) {

return skipHidden("");

}

const targetUuid = declaredTargets[0];

const targetDoc = await fromUuid(targetUuid);

const targetActor = targetDoc?.actor ?? targetDoc;

if (!targetActor) {

return skipHidden("");

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 3) Detect whether the CURRENT action is an attack

// Valid when:

// - weapon branch

// - listType = Attack

// - skill_type / skillTypeRaw = attack

// --------------------------------------------------

const listType = norm(

__PAYLOAD?.meta?.listType ??

__PAYLOAD?.listType ??

""

);

const skillTypeCandidates = [

__PAYLOAD?.core?.skillTypeRaw,

__PAYLOAD?.dataCore?.skillTypeRaw,

__PAYLOAD?.meta?.skillTypeRaw

].map(norm).filter(Boolean);

const detectedActionType = norm(

context.helpers?.getDetectedActionType?.() ?? ""

);

const weaponTypeHint = norm(

__PAYLOAD?.core?.weaponType ??

__PAYLOAD?.meta?.weaponTypeLabel ??

""

);

const isAttackAction =

listType === "attack" ||

skillTypeCandidates.includes("attack") ||

detectedActionType === "weapon" ||

!!weaponTypeHint;

if (!isAttackAction) {

return skipHidden("");

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 4) Count debuffs on the target

// Only Active Effects tagged "debuff" count.

// --------------------------------------------------

const toTagArray = (value) => {

if (value == null) return [];

if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.flatMap(toTagArray);

if (typeof value === "string") {

return value

.split(/[,\n]/)

.map(s => s.trim())

.filter(Boolean);

}

if (typeof value === "object") {

return Object.values(value).flatMap(toTagArray);

}

return [];

};

const effectHasDebuffTag = (effect) => {

const candidates = [

effect?.tags,

effect?.system?.tags,

effect?.flags?.world?.tags,

effect?.flags?.["custom-system-builder"]?.tags,

effect?.flags?.["fabula-ultima-companion"]?.tags,

effect?.getFlag?.("world", "tags"),

effect?.getFlag?.("custom-system-builder", "tags"),

effect?.getFlag?.("fabula-ultima-companion", "tags")

];

const tags = candidates.flatMap(toTagArray).map(norm).filter(Boolean);

return tags.includes("debuff");

};

const debuffCount = Array.from(targetActor?.effects ?? []).filter(effect => {

if (!effect || effect.disabled) return false;

return effectHasDebuffTag(effect);

}).length;

if (debuffCount <= 0) {

return skipHidden("");

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 5) Skill level

// --------------------------------------------------

const skillLevel = Math.max(

0,

Number(

passiveItem?.level ??

passiveItem?.system?.props?.level ??

passiveItem?.system?.level ??

0

) || 0

);

// --------------------------------------------------

// 6) Apply bonus to the REAL attack payload

// --------------------------------------------------

const bonusToAdd = skillLevel + debuffCount;

if (bonusToAdd <= 0) {

return skipHidden("");

}

__PAYLOAD.advPayload = __PAYLOAD.advPayload || {};

const bonusBefore = Number(__PAYLOAD.advPayload.bonus ?? 0) || 0;

__PAYLOAD.advPayload.bonus = bonusBefore + bonusToAdd;

__PAYLOAD.meta = __PAYLOAD.meta || {};

__PAYLOAD.meta.cheapShotDebug = {

mode: "main-attack-payload",

passiveOwner: passiveOwner?.name ?? null,

passiveItem: passiveItem?.name ?? null,

target: targetActor?.name ?? null,

targetUuid,

listType,

skillTypeCandidates,

detectedActionType,

weaponTypeHint,

skillLevel,

debuffCount,

bonusAdded: bonusToAdd,

bonusBefore,

bonusAfter: __PAYLOAD.advPayload.bonus

};

console.log(TAG, "APPLIED", __PAYLOAD.meta.cheapShotDebug);

context.log("Cheap Shot applied", __PAYLOAD.meta.cheapShotDebug);
